value.rationale: Uniform positive realness of a Gaussian-sketched SPD form is a natural sufficient stability property for signs of one-dimensional sketched Galerkin/harmonic projected scalars. The exact beta formula gives a sharp risk at every sketch size and spectral contrast; the k/kappa criterion is the exact oversampling scale needed to secure all adaptive directions. Contrasting the fixed and sketch-selected quantifiers prevents misuse of pointwise sign-preservation probability in adaptive Krylov numerical computations, without claiming an algorithm-wide convergence theorem.
